title: Concrete Gospel V3: Dark to Divine
description: Concrete Gospel V3 sketch. The approved V2 drums and 808 (unchanged) with THRONE//VOLT (lead), CATHEDRAL//ENGINE (harmony) and HEAVEN//MASS (choir).

tracks.description: IRON PULSE at C2 (body, gated 1/8) + skin slap C3 (knock) + log rim C5 (click), one hit = three layers.
TITANIUM CRACK -2 st + HEADLINER context snare + skin slap F3, gated short; TITANIUM ghosts.
V12 GHOST TICK and OPEN CIRCUIT: the backbeat left alone, triplets under the hook, two announcing rolls.
V12 CHROME STRIKE at F4 + F3: the bell that marks bars 1, 5, 13 and the end.
The same bell gated short on C5/F5: a sparse steel off-beat figure.
Living Bass played as a tuned sliding 808 (rack stem), ducked under every kick.
THRONE//VOLT: the V3 hook (rack stem). +1.5 dB from the slam, as V2 did for its lead.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Great with its Nave: the full-chorus hits (bars 13-14) and the final full organ.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Swell with its Nave: the chord responses (bars 5-11), the floor under the choir's answer, the amen.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Pedal: 16', resultant 32', 8', Posaune, only after the 808 dives away.
HEAVEN//MASS basses (octavists on the final chord) with their Nave; a 4 dB duck on each kick and snare.
HEAVEN//MASS tenors and altos with their Nave; a 2.5 dB duck on each kick and snare.
HEAVEN//MASS sopranos, second sopranos and descant with their Nave: back 2.5 dB under the lead's calls in the climax.
